# Plan: Deploy the game to GitHub Pages

## Design

Add `.github/workflows/pages.yml`, triggered on push to `main` and `workflow_dispatch`.

- `build` job: `contents: read`. Checkout without persisted credentials, set up Node 24.22.0 with the same pinned action SHAs as `browser-tests.yml`, `npm ci`, `npm run build`, upload `dist` with `actions/upload-pages-artifact`.
- `deploy` job: needs `build`, with only `pages: write` and `id-token: write`, in the `github-pages` environment, using `actions/deploy-pages`.
- `concurrency: pages` with `cancel-in-progress: false`, so a running deployment finishes.

Pages is already enabled with `build_type=workflow`. No secret or token is added, and nothing reaches the client bundle.

Export `SITE_BASE` from a new `site.config.ts` (default `/signal-lost/`, still overridable by `SIGNAL_LOST_BASE`), and import it in `vite.config.ts`. Add `tests/unit/pages.test.ts`:

- reads the Vite base and asserts `/signal-lost/`;
- runs `vite build` to a temporary directory with the project config and asserts `index.html` references its script under `/signal-lost/assets/`.

## Files

- New: `.github/workflows/pages.yml`, `site.config.ts`, `tests/unit/pages.test.ts`
- Changed: `vite.config.ts`, and `tsconfig.json` only if the new root file is not already included (`*.ts` already covers it)

## Edge cases

- A failed build must not deploy: `deploy` needs `build`.
- The test build must not touch `dist/`, because other checks may use it.

## Out of scope

The custom 404 page and post-deploy smoke verification, which belong to the release WorkUnit.

# Test plan

| Acceptance criterion | Verification |
| --- | --- |
| Workflow builds with `npm ci` and `npm run build`, and deploys `dist` on push to main and manual dispatch | Reviewer reads `pages.yml`. `actionlint` is not in the toolchain, so YAML is parsed with `npx prettier --check`. After merge, the run on `main` must succeed and `https://supernovae.github.io/signal-lost/` must return 200. |
| Built `index.html` references assets under `/signal-lost/` | `npx vitest run tests/unit/pages.test.ts` |

Developer runs the focused commands above and `npm run lint`. The coordinator runs the complete required policy.

VERDICT: CHANGES_REQUESTED

| Contract item | Audit |
| --- | --- |
| Deploy on main pushes and manual dispatch | Covered by the proposed triggers, build/upload steps, and dependent deploy job. |
| Least privilege; no client tokens | Covered by job-scoped permissions, credential-free checkout, and OIDC deployment. |
| Preserve existing workflows | Plan adds pages.yml and leaves both existing workflows unchanged. Harness changes are authorized. |
| Verify /signal-lost/ in configuration and built HTML | Covered by the proposed unit test reading Vite configuration and inspecting a temporary build. |
| Evidence and reproducible verification | Revisions required below. |

Required revisions:

1. PLAN.md states “Pages is already enabled with build_type=workflow” without a verifiable source. REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md repeats that assertion but supplies no independent evidence. Cite an existing settings observation, or label this as an unverified deployment prerequisite. Keep any post-merge settings/runtime verification outside sandbox implementation gates.
2. TEST_PLAN.md gives `npx prettier --check` without a file argument. Use `npx prettier --check .github/workflows/pages.yml` and distinguish YAML parsing/formatting from Actions semantics. Specify that source inspection checks both triggers, npm commands, dist artifact path, build dependency, environment, and job permissions.
3. Define tester ownership: independently inspect the implemented workflow and acceptance coverage, reuse applicable passing developer results, and repeat checks only for relevant changes, failures, or unresolved coverage. The coordinator alone runs the complete required policy. Treat the post-merge workflow/HTTP checks as follow-up observations, not prerequisites for completing sandbox validation.

Verified source: vite.config.ts already defaults to /signal-lost/ with SIGNAL_LOST_BASE override; tsconfig.json includes root *.ts; package.json supplies Vite, Vitest, and Prettier; browser-tests.yml confirms the planned Node version and checkout/setup-node pins. No new dependencies are needed. REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md contains only the prior design and test plan, with no additional reports or lessons.
